page.notes: Headings in the question lines are set in italic and centred, so they are given level 3. The initial G of GRAMMATICA is a decorated woodcut initial. The German passages are in black letter. The letter after I is printed as a bracket-like glyph; read as J with [?]. The Greek forms ϐ, γ and ϑ are doubtful in the scan and marked [?] where unclear. The spacing "Grammaticæ,in" is printed without a space; written with a space. Long s is written as s throughout. Printed "q;" in unaquæq; kept as printed.
